card.name: Words linking a change to baseline
card.fires_on: The small word after a number or threshold that leads into a reference level, such as 'from' before baseline, 'x' before ULN, or 'above' before baseline, in lab and ECG change descriptions.

modes.label: from baseline
modes.description: 'from' after a measured change, right before the word baseline.
modes.example: increases in QTcF of > 60 msec<< from>> baseline occurred in 7/49

modes.label: multiple of ULN
modes.description: The 'x' after a number in liver enzyme thresholds, before ULN.
modes.example: ALT or AST elevations Increase in ALT or AST > 6<< x>> ULN Discontinue eltrombop

modes.label: above or within baseline
modes.description: 'above' or 'the' linking a percent change to a baseline or pretreatment level.
modes.example: serum creatinine less than 30%<< above>> baseline), the dose may be increased by
